newsitem.title: UK: Crude aids NWE gasoline, Russians hurt fuel, gas oil.
newsitem.headline: Crude aids NWE gasoline, Russians hurt fuel, gas oil.

text.p: NWE gasoline was helped by firmer crude on Thursday, while Russian exports pressured gas oil and fuel markets, traders said.
Gasoline was firmer in line with NYMEX unleaded gains and news of crude run cuts at BP's Rotterdam refinery. Eurograde traded at around $210 for pre end-May delivery.
Naphtha was firm with crude and livelier gasoline.
Gas oil premiums weakened with trading focused on Russian cargoes which slipped by around $1.00 a tonne to trade at a low of June IPE +$2.00.
High sulphur barges traded flat and thin with Russian exports threatening to depress sagging prices even further. Low sulphur cargo markets were quiet.
